long_description:
It's time to grow yourself! Learn about our Devanadi 235/340hr Yoga Teacher Trainings and other programs, guests, and retreats. We’ll go over common Q & A, then help you with any additional questions, registration, application info, and more. These trainings are open to students who want to deepen their knowledge of yoga, begin or intensify their personal practice, or want to register with the Yoga Alliance as an RYT when completed. Bring your questions.

Come learn more about trainings, retreats and events we offer including:

• 235hr (RYT 200) Yoga Teacher Trainings

• 340hr (RYT 500) Yoga Teacher Trainings

• Reiki Trainings

• Thai Yoga Bodywork Trainings

• Guest & Specialty Trainings

• Ayurveda Trainings

• Upcoming Retreats (Clear Vision Retreat in Costa Rica, Thailand, Wild Rice Retreat, etc.)

Prerequisite: None

Cost: FREE
